Several shared bases from transmitted moments

Source: R/shared.R
pool_shared.Rd

Partitions the records into C groups and returns one basis per group. The receiver alternates between the leading k eigenvectors of each group sum and the assignment that retains the most of each moment, from starts random assignments. It uses only what the records have already transmitted, so no further communication from them is needed.

Usage

pool_shared(moments, k, C = 3L, starts = 10L, iters = 50L, seed = NULL)

Arguments

moments

A list of bp_moment objects.

k

Dimension of each basis.

C

Number of shared bases.

starts

Number of random initial assignments.

iters

Maximum number of alternations per start.

seed

Optional seed. The random state of the session is restored.

Value

An object of class bp_shared with the list of bases T, the assignment group and the objective value.

Examples

sim <- simulate_beats(H = 6, n = 50, p = 20, q = 3, seed = 3)
m <- lapply(sim$X, energy_moment, q = 5)
fit <- pool_shared(m, k = 2, C = 2, starts = 2, seed = 1)
fit$group
#> [1] 2 2 1 2 2 1
